title: Flax Crackers (Raw & Vegan)
excerpt: Flax seeds are rich in omega 3 making them fabulous for heart health.
content:
Flax seeds are rich in omega 3 making them fabulous for heart health. Dehydrate a large batch of these crispy crackers and keep them on hand as a snack throughout the week!

Ingredients:

  • 5 Red Peppers

  • ½ Red Onion

  • 3 Cloves Garlic

  • 3 T. Chili Powder

  • 2 ½ C Flax Seed

  • 1 C. Flax Seed, Ground

  • 5 oz. Fresh Lemon Juice

  • 3 Stalks Celery

  • 1 Tsp. Garlic Powder

  • 1 Pinch Cayenne Powder

  • 5 ½ C. Water

  • 1 T. Kelp Powder

Technique: 

  1. Soak 2 ½ C. flax seeds in 5 ½ cups water for at least 3 hours.

  2. Set Aside

  3. Blend remaining ingredients and add to soaked flax seeds.

  4. Mix in ground flax seed.

  5. Spread out on a Paraflex sheet.

  6. Score to desired size of crackers.

  7. Dehydrate at 110 degrees Fahrenheit overnight then peel of the Paraflex sheet.

  8. Dehydrate again until the crackers are crispy.
